nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
# AddisPulse H3 — Master 3

Every MiniMax H3 mode in one graph. Pick a mode with the purple toggles in
**① OPTIONS** (top right). Nothing else needs rewiring.

---

## Choosing a mode

| Mode | Branch | FIRST FRAME | LAST FRAME |
|---|---|---|---|
| **T2VA** text → video+audio | A | off | off |
| **I2VA** image opens the shot | A | **on** | off |
| **FL2VA** open *and* close | A | **on** | **on** |
| **L2VA** video arrives at image | A | off | **on** |
| **REF2VA** characters / voices | B | — | — |

**Branch A = `20 ▸ BRANCH A · FL2VA`** (the `fl2va` checkpoint)
**Branch B = `21 ▸ BRANCH B · REF2VA`** (the `ref2va` checkpoint)

> Exactly one branch on at a time. They are different checkpoints and cannot
> both load. If both are on, the switch takes Branch A.

### When to use which
- **T2VA** — no image, the text describes the whole shot.
- **I2VA** — one image, animate it, it opens the video.
- **FL2VA** — two images, first opens and second closes; the model builds the
  motion between them.
- **L2VA** — one image that is the *ending* frame; the shot develops toward it.
- **REF2VA** — you need a specific person, voice, or place to persist. Ships
  with the AddisPulse cast wired up.

---

## Ships as
Branch B (REF2VA) on, Branch A off — the AddisPulse setup unchanged. Flip the
two branch toggles to reach the video modes.

---

## Canvas and duration
**RATIO / RESOLUTION** and **DURATION** are shared by both branches.

Duration is seconds. `seconds → frames` converts at 24 fps and snaps to H3's
frame grid (17k+5), clamped at 362. **③ FRAME COUNT** shows the result — it must
land on that grid or the model errors.

H3's canvas caps at a 768px short edge, 768 x 1344 max, multiples of 32. The
resolution selector already respects this; don't push past it.

## Why the frame images get cropped
`first_frame` is stretched onto the canvas with cropping *disabled* — feed it a
mismatched aspect and it distorts. Each frame image therefore passes through
`ImageResizeKJv2` set to `keep_proportion = crop`, taking width/height from the
resolution selector, so it arrives pre-fitted. FL2VA also needs both frames on
the same canvas, which this guarantees.

Prefer a different crop? `crop_position` on those nodes: center, top, bottom,
left, right.

---

## Speed toggles
- **EasyCache** — off by default. Fastest win, softest motion. Try it on long clips.
- **Spectrum RAM offload** — on. Lets big clips fit; leave on unless VRAM-rich.
- **Sage Attention** — on. Near-free speedup.
- **Sigma Shift** — not a toggle. Raise for long clips that drift, lower if
  motion feels stiff.

## Seed
**② SEED** now drives `RandomNoise` directly. In the old master they were two
separate numbers you had to keep in sync by hand.

---

## Spectrum v0.1.8

`bootstrap_first_forecast` was added as a 12th input, defaulting to **true**.
Workflows saved before it existed carry only 11 values, so the node fills the
gap with that default — and it is only legal at `degree = 1`, which threw
`bootstrap_first_forecast requires degree == 1` on any saved graph running a
higher degree.

This workflow now stores all 12 values, with `bootstrap_first_forecast = false`,
keeping the `degree = 4` / `warmup_steps = 5` tuning behaving as it did before
the upgrade.

Two rules to respect if you retune:
- `bootstrap_first_forecast` requires `degree == 1` **and** `warmup_steps <= 1`
- `max_history` must be at least `degree + 1`

The two documented presets:

| | default | aggressive |
|---|---|---|
| `blend_weight` | 0.50 | 0.75 |
| `degree` | 1 | 4 |
| `flex_window` | 0.75 | 3.0 |
| `warmup_steps` | 1 | 5 |
| `bootstrap_first_forecast` | true | false |

`ridge_lambda` 0.10, `window_size` 2.0, `tail_actual_steps` 1, `max_history` 8
in both.
